mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_incident_keyword (incident_id, keyword_id, weight) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{keywordId}, COALESCE(#{weight}, 1.00)) ON CONFLICT (incident_id, keyword_id) DO UPDATE SET weight = EXCLUDED.weight
mapper.select: SELECT sik.incident_id, sik.keyword_id, sik.weight, k.category FROM safety_incident_keyword sik JOIN safety_keyword k ON k.id = sik.keyword_id WHERE sik.incident_id = #{incidentId}
